collection_never_blocks_the_monitor: the scheduled tick runs this program as a subprocess and records its exit status; a refused read cannot stop a sample from being taken

event_identifier_candidates.classification_rule: a record is classified by its channel, its task path, its instance identifiers and its instants; the identifier alone never establishes that a run was scheduled

semantics.reason: no declaration of the identifiers' meaning exists for this host, and none may be invented here: the identifiers are read as candidates and a record is classified by its fields

events_missing_or_unobtainable.why: the operational channel is disabled on this host and the change that would enable it was refused without an elevated token; the maintenance channel carries only identifiers 800 and 808, none of which describes a task's execution

growth.bound: one record per (channel, EventRecordID), deduplicated on write; the store is never an export of the whole log and never grows by a re-read

purpose: the durable, deduplicated record of the Task Scheduler events this host produced, and an honest account of the events it could not produce or could not be read

retention.policy: the store holds only records of the monitored task, one per EventRecordID, and is preserved until the period closes; the log itself is never exported wholesale
